answer: SELECT f.CDSCode, ROUND(f."FRPM Count (K-12)"*1.0/f."Enrollment (K-12)",6) AS rate FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode=f.CDSCode WHERE s.SOC='66' ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT s.MailStreet, s.School FROM satscores a JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode=a.cds WHERE a.rtype='S' AND a.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
note: school-level rows only; district rows excluded

answer: SELECT s.City FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.CDSCode='01611920113902'

SELECT s.School, s.Phone FROM satscores a JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode=a.cds WHERE a.rtype='S' AND s.DOC='03' AND a.NumGE1500=(SELECT MAX(a2.NumGE1500) FROM satscores a2 JOIN schools s2 ON s2.CDSCode=a2.cds WHERE a2.rtype='S' AND s2.DOC='03')

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(GSserved LIKE 'K%')>0 THEN 'K' ELSE MIN(substr(GSserved,1,instr(GSserved||'-','-')-1)) END AS lowest_grade FROM schools WHERE NCESDist='0632640' AND School IS NOT NULL AND School<>'' AND GSserved IS NOT NULL
note: used grades served (K), not offered (P); ambiguous

answer: SELECT SOCType AS "School Type", School, Latitude FROM schools WHERE Latitude=(SELECT MAX(Latitude) FROM schools WHERE SOCType IN ('Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)','Junior High Schools (Public)') OR School LIKE '%Middle%') AND (SOCType IN ('Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)','Junior High Schools (Public)') OR School LIKE '%Middle%')

SELECT s.School, s.District, s.County, a.AvgScrWrite FROM schools s JOIN satscores a ON a.cds=s.CDSCode WHERE s.StatusType='Closed' AND a.rtype='S' AND a.AvgScrWrite=(SELECT MAX(a2.AvgScrWrite) FROM schools s2 JOIN satscores a2 ON a2.cds=s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.StatusType='Closed' AND a2.rtype='S' AND a2.AvgScrWrite<(SELECT MAX(a3.AvgScrWrite) FROM schools s3 JOIN satscores a3 ON a3.cds=s3.CDSCode WHERE s3.StatusType='Closed' AND a3.rtype='S'))

SELECT f."County Name" AS county, COUNT(*) AS num_schools, ROUND(AVG(ROUND(100.0*f."Free Meal Count (K-12)"/f."Enrollment (K-12)",2)),2) AS avg_free_pct, ROUND(AVG(ROUND(100.0*f."FRPM Count (K-12)"/f."Enrollment (K-12)",2)),2) AS avg_frpm_pct, SUM(f."Charter School (Y/N)"=1) AS charter, SUM(f."Charter School (Y/N)"=0) AS non_charter, ROUND(AVG(a.AvgScrRead+a.AvgScrMath+a.AvgScrWrite),2) AS avg_sat FROM frpm f LEFT JOIN satscores a ON a.cds=f.CDSCode WHERE f."County Name"=(SELECT "County Name" FROM frpm WHERE CDSCode='01612590125716') AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)">500 AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)"<700 GROUP BY f."County Name"
SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) AS magnet_provision2_schools FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.Magnet=1 AND f."NSLP Provision Status"='Provision 2' GROUP BY s.City ORDER BY s.City

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode=f.CDSCode WHERE s.County='Los Angeles' AND f."School Type" IN ('High Schools (Public)','Continuation High Schools','High Schools In 1 School Dist. (Public)') AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)">500 ORDER BY s.School
